# New America

> New America is a think tank focused on policy innovation in housing, family support systems, and civic engagement through research, fellowships, and data infrastructure initiatives.

New America conducts research and develops policy solutions across critical areas including affordable housing, equitable care systems, and American civic identity. The organization combines data-driven analysis with fellowship programs to drive systemic change and public understanding.

## Key Topics

- housing policy
- affordable housing
- missing-middle housing
- housing loss tracking
- national standards
- eviction data
- renter protection
- data infrastructure
- family support systems
- equitable care
- civic engagement
- journalism
- fellowship programs
- displacement measurement
- housing innovation

## Housing & Land Policy

- [Establishing a National Housing Loss Rate](https://www.newamerica.org/impact/establishing-a-national-housing-loss-rate): New America's Future of Land and Housing program establishing national housing loss tracking standards and data infrastructure for measuring displacement.

## Family & Care Systems

- [Thriving Families](https://www.newamerica.org/issues/thriving-families): New America's Thriving Families initiative addressing equitable care systems and comprehensive family support policies.

## Fellowships & Civic Engagement

- [Us@250 Fellowship](https://www.newamerica.org/fellowships/us250-fellowship): Us@250 Fellowship program supporting journalism and civic engagement around American identity and democratic participation.
